issues: Some technical terms are not translated accurately, e.g., 'Model Context Protocol' as 'मॉडल कॉन्टेक्स्ट प्रोटोकॉल' instead of 'मॉडल संदर्भ प्रोटोकॉल' or 'मॉडल संदर्भ प्रोटोकॉल' (MCP).
The translation of 'chain-of-thought' and 'tree-of-thoughts' as 'चेन-ऑफ-थॉट' and 'ट्री-ऑफ-थॉट्स' is not standard and may be confusing for readers.
The translation of 'rollback' as 'रोलबैक' is not commonly used in Hindi technical writing and may be unfamiliar to readers.
